thread:
marie (Design): quick run-through — found a few tiny a11y + UX issues in the trace viewer. sharing a short list, please chime in
sam (Eng Runtime): thanks — link?
marie (Design): https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/trace-viewer — look at the stackframe flyout and the export menu :eyes:
kyle (Product): overall looks cleaner! what's the a11y problem specifically?
marie (Design): 1) the small copy icon next to each stack line is 18px hit area — hard for keyboard/low-motor users. 2) copy-to-clipboard doesn't announce success to screen readers. 3) truncated function names have no tooltip on focus (only hover). 4) export action currently only offers JSON; customers asked for CSV for analysis.
anya (SRE): +1 on the screen reader bit — we still have instances where NVDA/VoiceOver don't get a confirmation. any proposed fixes?
marie (Design): proposed changes: increase target to 32px, make the copy a button element with aria-label="Copy stack line" and aria-live="polite" toast for SRs, and add keyboard shortcut to copy full trace (Ctrl+Shift+C). Also add a focus tooltip for truncated names. For export: add CSV option and expose a minimal columns selector.
sam (Eng Runtime): implementation notes: increasing hit area is easy with CSS padding. aria-live toasts — fine. Keyboard shortcut needs to avoid collisions, but Ctrl+Shift+C seems OK. For copy full trace, we should stream rather than build a giant string to avoid blocking main thread for long traces.
kyle (Product): product question — for CSV, what columns do we include? timestamp, service, span_id, message, stack_line?
marie (Design): suggest core columns: timestamp, trace_id, span_id, service, filename, lineno, function, message. CSV export should have a "collapse frames" toggle to reduce noise.
anya (SRE): about trace_id/correlation IDs — when copy single line we should also include a small context menu to 'copy with trace id' because engineers often paste both. Maybe long-press or modifier (Shift+click) to copy full context.
sam (Eng Runtime): Shift+click is doable. On mobile we can expose long-press as well. We should also ensure copy actions go through the same analytics event so we can measure usage.
marie (Design): accessibility nit: keyboard focus order in the flyout jumps from the header to the export button to the last frame — should be linear through frames. I'll update the spec.
kyle (Product): timeline — can we land the hit area + aria-live this sprint and CSV next? customers flagged the copy behaviour as highest priority.
sam (Eng Runtime): we can do hit area + aria-live + analytics in this sprint. CSV will need a tiny backend endpoint to flatten traces; add to backlog for next sprint.
marie (Design): mock update pushed to figma with annotations. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/abcd1234 (annotated). Please review for copy: the toast says "Copied" now — should it be "Copied to clipboard"?
kyle (Product): prefer "Copied to clipboard" — explicit. add a short SR label: aria-live should say "Copied to clipboard: [function name]"
anya (SRE): one more: when exporting CSV, remove PII by default and show a confirmation modal listing columns that might contain sensitive data.
marie (Design): noted — will add modal copy and risk note.
aria-bot (ops): deploy-bot: scheduled perf test for streaming copy implemented by Eng Runtime on 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC
sam (Eng Runtime): thanks — I'll start a PR for the hit-area + aria-live. tagging @marie for design review in code comments. :thumbsup:
marie (Design): perfect, thanks team. will update the spec and post a small accessibility checklist in the thread.
